articles.title: Catching Edge-Case Bugs Early with TLA+ and Statecharts
articles.excerpt: Introduction When you write code with Coding Agent (Claude Code in this case), you normally write unit, integration and end-to-end tests to prevent some of future feature implementation or bug fix, or…
articles.body: Introduction When you write code with Coding Agent (Claude Code in this case), you normally write unit, integration and end-to-end tests to prevent some of future feature implementation or bug fix, or refactor codes effects to the current behaviors of the application. But what about edge-case bugs? We don't know how to catch those kind of bugs until you know and write a test case for it based on domain logic or it happened in the production environment, and you treat it as a bug and try to fix it after it happen. But what about catching and fixing it during the time you implement the feature? When you implement the application logic, it normally works like a logic flow or state machine, right? And with the state machine, you can let the coding agent detect all the flows for you.

articles.body: Câu "PHP chết sau mỗi request" được lặp lại nhiều đến mức nhiều dev tin rằng mỗi request đều khởi động lại toàn bộ PHP. Thực tế không phải vậy. Thứ bị dọn sau mỗi request là request state : biến, object, static property. Process PHP-FPM vẫn sống, và OPcache vẫn giữ bytecode trong shared memory. Hiểu đúng ranh giới này giúp bạn tune server có cơ sở, đọc đúng số liệu, và tránh một loại bug rất nguy hiểm khi chuyển sang worker mode. Bài này đi qua những gì thực sự xảy ra bên trong Zend Engine, kèm các lệnh và config dùng được ngay với PHP 8.4 trở lên. Điều gì sống, điều gì chết sau một request? PHP có hai vòng đời lồng nhau. Vòng ngoài là của process: module startup (MINIT) chạy khi process khởi động, module shutdown (MSHUTDOWN) chạy khi process tắt.

articles.body: 打开一个运营了几年的游戏平台，大厅里往往躺着上千款游戏。玩家的耐心却很有限，多数人只会看首屏和前几行。于是“热门”“新游”“厂商分类”这类固定栏目，成了大厅的默认答案。 问题在于，这套答案对所有人都一样。偏爱快节奏即开类游戏的玩家，和习惯真人桌游的玩家，看到的是同一份榜单。 本文想聊三件事 ： 大厅只靠“榜单”一层排序时，千人一面就会出现。 破局要同时满足五个需求：数据洞察、智能游戏推荐与精准分发、反应够快、千人千面、AI 赋能。 做法可以拆成“兜底层 + 个性化层 + 推荐算法”三层叠加，再用闭环持续运转。 假设一个平台的大厅里有三千款游戏。一位新玩家进来，向下滑了三四屏，没找到想玩的，就退出了。他想玩的游戏很可能就在这三千款里，等着被放到他面前。 多数平台的默认答案，是“热门”“新游”“厂商分类”这几行固定栏目。它们对所有人都一样：排在前面的游戏获得更多曝光，更多曝光带来更多点击，长尾游戏几乎没有被看见的机会。游戏库买了很多，真正被玩到的只是一小部分。 这就是游戏大厅的“千人一面”。 千人一面，是怎么形成的 热门榜单反映的是“多数人”的选择，它有三个天然的短板： 强者恒强。 排前面的游戏获得更多曝光，也就获得更多点击，长尾游戏几乎没有机会。 忽略个体差异。 榜单无法区分玩家的口味、节奏和习惯。 新游戏难出头。 榜单依赖历史数据，新上线的游戏天然处于劣势。 热门榜很适合做完全陌生访客的兜底。对于老玩家以及当它独自撑起整个大厅时，智能推荐就应该出现。 破局之前，先列清需求 怎么破？先别急着谈算法，我们把大厅需要做到的事情列出来： 玩家行为数据构建。 每位玩家有自己的兴趣画像，根据个人喜好和行为动态调整推荐内容。 新玩家和新游戏有办法。 没有数据的时候，也不能让大厅失真或空白。 数据说了算。 玩家行为数据怎么用、谁能看、能保留多久，都要有明确的边界。 反应要快。 玩家刚点开某…

articles.title: How to keep API keys out of AI-generated code
articles.excerpt: Practical checklist from ShipSafeStack. Not a penetration test, compliance audit, score, or proof that an app is safe to launch. Informational only — no guarantees. The frontend checklist is how to se…
articles.body: Practical checklist from ShipSafeStack . Not a penetration test, compliance audit, score, or proof that an app is safe to launch. Informational only — no guarantees. The frontend checklist is how to search the bundle after the app is built. This page is how to keep the secret out of the code an agent writes. They overlap — do both. Hand the agent a name, not a value Agents inline a key because the request fails without it. Put the value in the host’s secret store, or in a local file that git and the agent ignore, and tell the agent the variable name . Vendor docs (as of the guide on ShipSafeStack): Cursor: .env is ignored by default; .cursorignore can block extra paths. A terminal command or MCP tool can still read an ignored file.

articles.title: Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find
articles.excerpt: A meteor that exploded into fragments that fell into Cape Cod Bay was once part of the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter, scientists found.
articles.body: Thanks to a combination of radar, infrasound, dash-cam and security camera footage, astronomers have tracked the bright daytime meteor that fell over Cape Cod Bay in May 2026 back to its origin as a small asteroid perturbed by Jupiter and sent on a comet-like orbit towards Earth. Meteor fireballs visible in the daytime are referred to as 'bolides'. At 1:06 p.m. local time (18:06 UTC) on May 30, 2026 one such bolide was widely witnessed falling out of the sky over coastal Massachusetts, with members of the public also reporting an associated sonic boom that rumbled across the north-eastern coast of the United States.

articles.title: Exterminauts Turns You and 2 Friends Into Intergalactic Pest Control Techs With Some Really Spicy Secondary Weapons | IGN Preview
articles.excerpt: I've played about five hours of the blue-collar bug-squasher so far, and admittedly it’s grown on me. The special launcher weapons and diverse array of weird-ass bugs keeps skirmishes interesting, and…
articles.body: Key Preview Takeaways: Exterminauts feels a bit generic at first. Its default weapons aren’t very new or exciting, but the secondary weapons are far more interesting. There is a meta to engage with. Horde shooters are really the perfect games to double as a hang with your friends, as the objectives are typically pretty simple and clear, letting you chat hot goss over comms while you’re ripping hot lead in game. Because of this (and the key successes of a handful of them) these games are kind of everywhere in 2026, and after some hands on time with Exterminauts, a third-person co-op shooter that puts mad science tools in your hands in order to defend and upkeep the assets of your capitalist overlords, I think that fact is going to be their biggest issue.

articles.title: NASA unveils $10 billion in moon base contracts, new lunar missions and the 'PROMISE' of a nuclear-powered rover
articles.excerpt: NASA is pushing ahead with its plan to build a moon base for astronauts by 2032, unveiling up to $10 billion in new contracts to launch and deliver cargo to Earth's nearest neighbor.
articles.body: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA is pushing ahead with its plan to build a moon base for astronauts by 2032, with the agency unveiling up to $10 billion in contracts to launch and deliver cargo to the moon and other efforts on Saturday (Nov. 7). The NASA announcement, revealed here during the space agency's "Max Power" air show event at Kennedy Space Center , included plans for a new $10 billion Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) framework, dubbed CLPS 2, about$1.3 billion in funding for the agency's Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) program, and the nuclear-powered "PROMISE" rover on the moon.
articles.author: Josh Dinner

articles.title: NASA chief Jared Isaacman skydives into space agency's MAX POWER air show — 'Going into this job, I knew we had to do something like this.'
articles.excerpt: "I promise you, there'll be more to come."
articles.body: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman knows how to make an entrance. Under the bright afternoon sun on Saturday (Nov. 7), Isaacman plummeted through the air above 10,000 onlookers, skydiving into the agency's air show MAX POWER. MAX POWER overtook NASA's Kennedy Space Center here over the weekend, combining aeronautics and aerospace in a massive public air show, the first of its kind for the space agency. A mix of astronauts, fighter jet displays and new technology on display, the spectacle is a lot space-ier than a traditional air show, and Isaacman made sure to really showcase this merging of worlds.

articles.title: Yes, it runs 'Doom': Satellite plays iconic game in world's 1st demonstration of orbital voice control
articles.excerpt: The world's first voice command of a satellite saw an experimental European spacecraft play the iconic video game 'Doom' after operators spoke to it from Earth.
articles.body: A satellite went knee-deep in the dead, after a voice command from the ground activated the Doom video game in space. Playing a first-person shooter from 1993 was obviously not in the design plan for the PRETTY cubesat , which is run by a consortium including the European Space Agency (ESA). But the pioneering voice command opens up new worlds for satellite work, the team says. "Someone in distress at sea or in a remote area could transmit 'mayday' or "help" on a radio," stated Estonia's Tanagra Space, which supplied the software for the feat. The hope is one day, a satellite could use transcription and AI to alert rescue services for assisting folks in remote zones. The call to play Doom, thankfully, had no other urgency than curiosity — and teamwork, fueled by pizza.

articles.body: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence.
